env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s guru-template/overlay/verify/tests -p 'test_start_guard.py' -v

invariants.rule: Requirements and detail records share one current Full confirmation batch id, batch digest, and canonical projection digest.
invariants.positive_case: The real writer emits one peer batch that the real validator accepts.
invariants.negative_case: Either record diverges or carries an unknown, missing, or mutated projection field.

invariants.rule: check-start independently recomputes current requirements, detail, complete sorted risk-packet bytes, and the self-verifying confirmation projection.
invariants.positive_case: Current inputs and exact peer records reach START_READY.
invariants.negative_case: Requirements, detail, risk-set, actor, time, scope, action, prompt, batch, optional metadata, or projection-digest drift reaches start.
